name: arugula-editor
description: Your editor in the Arugula swarm: who's in which file, follow its cursor from a phone, debugger stops and Claude Code's diffs on the rail. And Arugula's colours.

commands.title: Show this workspace in the swarm
Take this workspace out of the swarm

arugula.block.description: The editor block this window is (Arugula sets it in the block's workspace).

arugula.socket.description: The Arugula daemon's socket on this machine [default: $ARUGULA_SOCK, else ~/.local/state/arugula/sock]. Read as `illogical.socket` if this isn't set.

arugula.sshHost.description: Under Remote-SSH: the host name your desktop uses for this machine, for "Open here" links [default: its hostname].
